config.gog.name: Name
config.gog.intro: Use separate Google accounts alongside the native integration.
config.gog.cloud_help: Create an OAuth web client in Google Cloud, enable the selected APIs and configure the consent screen. Register the redirect URL shown during connection.
config.gog.grants_help: Enable each permission explicitly. Creation and export of Office files also require the matching Drive permission.
config.section.gog.label: Google Workspace via gog
config.section.gog.desc: Reaches additional Google accounts through the external gog command-line tool.
config.gog.test_object: Document ID for Docs, Sheets or Slides test
config.gog.confirm_disconnect_message: The Google sign-in of "{name}" is removed. The agent and the desktop lose access to this account until you connect it again.
config.gog.confirm_remove_message: Account "{name}" with its client ID and service permissions is removed from the list and deleted when you save.
config.gog.login_opened: Login window opened. Finish the sign-in there; the status updates once the account is connected.
config.gog.login_not_connected: Sign-in is not complete yet: the account is still not connected.
config.gog.enabled_help: Turns on the gog link to Google accounts. It adds further accounts to the built-in Google Workspace integration.
config.gog.readonly_help: The agent may only read through gog. Creating, changing, deleting and sending stay blocked even if an account allows them.
config.gog.name_help: Display name of the account, such as "Personal" or "Work".
config.gog.account_enabled_help: Only enabled accounts can be used by the agent and the desktop.
config.gog.agent_help: The agent may use this account with the permissions granted below.
config.gog.desktop_help: Desktop apps may use this account, for example for mail or calendar.
config.gog.client_id_help: Client ID of the OAuth web client from the Google Cloud Console.
config.gog.secret_help: Client secret of the OAuth client. "Save in Vault" stores it encrypted; it is not shown again.
